inspection_history: V1/V3 and V3 residuals across all outer folds have been inspected. All pre-holdout evidence remains DEVELOPMENT, never pristine confirmation.

spline.extrapolation: training-range clipped spline components; shared linear components retained

family_interactions: Four geometry deviations per populated family with L2 shrinkage toward shared slopes; no families excluded.

context.alignment: Exact last-closed candle timestamp equals decision timestamp; BTC/ETH same boundary; fixed trailing windows; all SQL bounds strictly pre-holdout.

sampling: Same V3 deterministic every-twelfth canonical label-ID sample and identical outer test indices. No subset selection.
outer_folds: Same six equal chronological pre-holdout windows, seed 0 and evaluation 1..5. Strict complete-horizon maturity before each training cutoff.
inner_folds: Three equal windows of each outer training prefix; seed 0 and validations 1,2. Lowest pooled inner Brier selects C per family and the family for the nested procedure; ties follow registry order then smaller C. Outer scores never select a family.
final_selection: The last outer training prefix's inner selection determines final family/C; final fitting uses all matured pre-holdout development labels.
calibration_layer: NONE; do not tune on outer predictions. Report empirical binned resolution/reliability differences with within-bin residual and calibration-layer gain zero.

payoff.quantile_crossing_policy: sort predicted quantiles without consulting outcomes
payoff.training: Shared, fixed payoff model fit once per outer training prefix; labels are supervised targets only. Every binary candidate uses its own p with the same conditional means.
